title: Year-End Review: How Sign Shop Owners Are Closing 2025 Strong
description: Join Joe and Liz as they close out 2025 with a special panel discussion featuring veteran sign shop owners sharing their strategies for finishing the year strong and planning for success in 2026.
keyTakeaways: Review your wins and losses from the past year to identify patterns
Set specific, measurable goals for the new year
Build relationships during slow seasons to prepare for busy times
Invest in your team's development during year-end
Document processes now to scale efficiently next year
